concerns.text: FR-009 (sensitivity analysis via Gaussian noise injection, σ=0.5°) is anchored to US-3 but has NO corresponding success criterion. No SC defines what is measured (variance in model accuracy across noise sweeps) or against which reference it is verified. Add an SC (e.g. SC-007) covering FR-009, or note the measurement source in an existing SC.

Edge case 'identical trajectory for success and failure' requires the evaluation to report a confusion matrix and flag ambiguous-subset accuracy < 50% as a limitation, but no FR or SC covers confusion-matrix reporting or the ambiguous-subset flag. This story-level behavior is silently under-specified.

Edge case 'baseline models fail to converge' requires the evaluation script to detect baseline accuracy < 55% and flag the comparison as potentially invalid, but no FR or SC captures this underpowered-baseline detection requirement.
